name: space-adventure-art
description: glTF 2.0 binary assets and manifest for Space Adventure; scripts verify them.

scripts.gen: python3 tools/gen_ship.py && python3 tools/gen_target.py && python3 tools/gen_struct.py && python3 tools/gen_kit.py && python3 tools/gen_nodes.py && python3 tools/gen_weapon.py && python3 tools/gen_icons.py
scripts.import: for r in recipes/*.json; do node tools/import_pack.mjs "$r" || exit 1; done
